ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-03-15
Provider: Dr. Marcus Rodriguez, MD
Department: Emergency Medicine
Visit Type: ed

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Muscle aches, fever, and facial swelling for the past five days

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
He returned from a hunting trip in Montana two weeks ago, during which he consumed grilled meat prepared over a campfire. He denies any cough, sore throat, or recent sick contacts. He initially felt fine but developed low-grade fevers and vague abdominal discomfort three days after returning home. Over the past few days, he has developed worsening myalgias, fatigue, and noticeable puffiness around his eyes.

PAST SURGICAL HISTORY:
- Tonsillectomy age 8

ALLERGIES:
NKDA

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Father: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Mother: Hypothyroidism
- Sibling: Healthy

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Never smoker. Alcohol: Social, 3-4 drinks per week. Occupation: Construction foreman.

VITAL SIGNS:
His temperature is 38.3°C (101°F), blood pressure 118/72 mm Hg, and heart rate 92/min.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On physical exam, he has bilateral periorbital edema and tenderness to palpation of his thighs and upper arms.

LABORATORY DATA:
Labs reveal leukocytosis with eosinophilia and mildly elevated creatine kinase.

attachments.text:
ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2021-03-15
Provider: Dr. Priya Patel, MD
Department: Internal Medicine
Visit Type: inpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
1-week history of progressive muscle soreness, swelling around the eyes, and a diffuse rash

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
The patient returns for inpatient care one year after his prior Emergency Department visit for similar complaints. He reports his symptoms started with abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting about 3 weeks ago, which resolved spontaneously. He denies recent travel but mentions eating undercooked pork at a local fair 2 weeks prior to symptom onset.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Trichinellosis (diagnosed 2020-03-15)

PAST SURGICAL HISTORY:
- Tonsillectomy age 8

MEDICATIONS:
He takes no medications

ALLERGIES:
NKDA

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Father: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Mother: Hypothyroidism
- Sibling: Healthy

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Never smoker. Alcohol: Social, 3-4 drinks per week. Occupation: Construction foreman.

VITAL SIGNS:
His temperature is 38.3°C (101°F).

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
On examination, he has periorbital edema, muscle tenderness on palpation, and subungual splinter hemorrhages.

LABORATORY DATA:
Laboratory findings are as follows:

- White blood cell count: 12,000/mm³
- Hemoglobin: 14 g/dL
- Eosinophil count: 2,000/mm³ (16% of WBCs)
- Creatine kinase (CK): 600 U/L (normal: 38-174 U/L)
- Alanine aminotransferase (ALT): 45 U/L (normal: 7-56 U/L)
- Aspartate aminotransferase (AST): 50 U/L (normal: 8-48 U/L)
